verdict.rationale: Checkout.com offers Payment Links that can be shared over email, SMS and social, and it markets them as needing no coding, with a dedicated 'Create a Payment Link' guide. Two parts of the story are weaker. The evidence never explicitly says links are created in the Dashboard UI. And 'start selling immediately' is undercut because pricing and onboarding are sales-led: merchants must contact the team to set up a plan. Missing for 10: explicit Dashboard-based link creation flow, self-serve instant go-live without a sales conversation, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
